notes:
### Added
- **Wishlist tab.** A dedicated bottom tab lists wanted cards with their
  owned/missing status, lets you sort (Recently added / Name / Set) and prune
  rows without opening each card, and shows an estimated **cost to pick up** the
  ones you don't own (from cached Near-Mint prices, flagged when partial) with a
  refresh action.

### Notes
- No scan-index rebuild required: the descriptor, `SCAN_VERSION`, `DATA_VERSION`
  and card data are untouched.
